answer: Bind each identity to one distinct registered vessel, verified by its hull identification number in the maritime registry and rechecked each epoch with paid mooring and insurance. One hull anchors one agent, and a hull cannot be cloned: a farm must buy, berth and maintain a separate boat per fake. An honest agent keeps one vessel off the reef, its jade marker steady on the horizon, while a thousand fakes need a thousand real hulls in real water.
